reader_summary.overview: After our recent podcast conversation, Matt Breitfelder, Partner and Global Head of Human Capital at Apollo, asked me if he could turn the tables and. We did that and added a two-way conversation about public speaking. Our conversation covers my path to the podcast, preparation for interviews, components of what makes it work, and tips for asking good questions.

key_points.text: After our recent podcast conversation, Matt Breitfelder, Partner and Global Head of Human Capital at Apollo.
We then turn to public speaking, focusing on the challenges and techniques for moderating panels and presenting in public.
